description: Address review findings: fix DELETE key mismatch, mask API keys in GET, deactivate orphaned keys on user deletion, bootstrap first user as admin, add password length cap at 72 chars.
steps: Step 1: Fix DELETE handler in src/app/api/multi/keys/route.js to also read key ID from request body as fallback when query param is empty.
Step 2: Mask API keys in GET /api/multi/keys response - show only first 10 chars + '...' instead of full key value.
Step 3: In src/lib/multiUser/userDb.js deleteUser(), deactivate orphaned apiKeys (set isActive=0) for keys linked in userApiKeys before deleting.
Step 4: In src/app/api/multi/register/route.js, check if users table is empty and set first user role to admin.
Step 5: Add password max length validation (72 chars) in register and profile routes.
acceptance_criteria: DELETE key works when ID sent in request body
GET /api/multi/keys returns masked key values (first 10 chars + '...')
Deleting a user deactivates their linked API keys
First registered user gets admin role
Passwords longer than 72 characters are rejected with an error
